scope: 17 additional route designs plus expanded Portfolio; existing ten reference screens retained
precedence: Current Research navigation: DeFi, RWAs, Markets and Venue map. The original solid-egg Nest logo remains selected. Saved/detail are utility routes; Automations remains in Lab. See discovery.json for the v0.4 additions.

records.title: Protocol detail
records.before: Only a compact facts modal existed.
records.design: Description, scoped metrics, markets, audit/admin/oracle coverage, source website and action entry points.
records.states: Unavailable history; research-only opportunity; partial source data

records.title: RWA asset detail
records.design: Issuer/platform, source identity, regulatory facts, eligibility/redemption unknown states and execution eligibility.
records.states: Unverified identity; unknown eligibility; no executable liquidity

records.title: Saved research
records.design: Search, remove and export bookmarked protocols, assets and saved filters; guest persistence boundary.

records.title: Direct supply
records.before: Borrow and positions existed; Supply mode was missing.
records.design: Amount/horizon comparison, rates and incentives separately, exclusions and withdrawal disclosure before review.
records.states: Changed input invalidates results; missing source; no comparable route

records.title: Portfolio overview
records.before: A sparse two-row overview needed expansion.
records.design: Assets minus liabilities, wallet/supply/vault/credit groups, exits, pending workflows, valuation and cost-basis coverage.
records.states: Partial valuations; unknown imported basis; no double counting

records.title: Receive & funding
records.design: Account/network/memo, trustline/reserve/activation, external-provider availability, on-chain arrival verification.
records.planned_api: Stellar account adapter; configured funding provider
records.states: Unfunded account; pending arrival; missing trustline; provider unavailable

records.title: Send assets
records.design: Amount, destination and memo, receiver inspection, fee/reserve checks and shared review gate.
records.planned_api: Typed transfer intent; receiver resolve; plans prepare
records.states: Invalid amount/account/memo; insufficient spendable; network mismatch

records.title: Action history
records.before: Only a short activity section existed.
records.design: Search/filter/export history and links from actions to plan lifecycle.
records.states: No results; pending receipt; failed or cancelled action

records.title: Plan lifecycle & recovery
records.before: Shared review existed; no persistent execution-status screen.
records.design: Signature/submission/reconciliation/next signature/external/partial/confirmed/error specimens with exact revision and separate recovery review.
records.states: Awaiting signature; submitted; reconciling; partial completion; confirmed; failed; expired; cancelled

records.title: Redemptions & campaign lots
records.before: Product facts existed; owned-position management was incomplete.
records.design: Request/settlement/claim, pending receivable accounting, per-lot selection and explicit unvested reward forfeiture.
records.states: Pending settlement; claimable; lot amount invalid; rewards lost

records.title: Automation detail & evaluations
records.before: Builder existed; durable history and proposal detail were missing.
records.design: Pinned rule revision, true/false/unknown evaluations, dedup/cooldown evidence, proposal review, pause/resume.
records.states: Source unavailable; unknown skip; dedup; proposed action; paused

records.title: Connections
records.before: Connect X stub existed; access/health management missing.
records.design: Granted scopes, entitlement, budgets, dependent paused rules and reconnect/disconnect consequences.
records.states: Expired; revoked; unauthorized endpoint; reconnect does not activate

records.title: Alerts inbox
records.design: Risk/source/workflow alerts, inspect targets and mark-read specimen.
records.states: Unread/read; native-risk warning; pending settlement; source auth

records.title: Conversation workspace
records.before: Only a static assistant drawer existed.
records.design: History switcher, source-linked messages, typed proposals, streaming/progress/stop/retry, provider/quota states.
records.planned_api: Agent conversation + turn APIs; application plan events
records.states: Guest; verified history; streaming; stopped; provider error; quota

records.title: Guardrails state review
records.before: Drawer existed; conflict/saved/scope states were missing.
records.design: Revision/draft distinction, validation errors, preserved conflict draft and scope changes.
records.planned_api: GET /api/policy; POST /api/policy/revisions with expected revision and idempotency
records.states: Dirty; invalid; conflict; saved; wallet/network change

records.title: Wallet access & verification
records.design: Guest, read-only watch, provider connection, ownership challenge, mismatch and cancelled/expired session.
records.states: Guest; watched; unverified; challenge rejected; account/network mismatch

records.title: Backtest run inspection
records.before: Runner existed; reproducibility and run-detail coverage incomplete.
records.design: Pinned assumptions, same-dataset comparison, unsupported models and coverage; working runner remains linked.
records.planned_api: P1 backtest run and event APIs
records.states: Synthetic data; unavailable historical data; missing model

records.title: Learning-run draft
records.before: Explicit deferred spec had no design.
records.design: Bounded objective, tools, read/runtime budget, stop reasons, findings and explicit acceptance boundary.
records.states: Draft; budget exhausted; cancelled; complete; proposals unaccepted

fixture_rules: No live wallet, server session, policy save, OAuth, scheduler, submission or claim is executed.
Decimal inputs remain strings. Number use in illustrative return and forfeiture math is for specimen only; production uses server fixed-point.
No valid funding address, QR or fabricated receipt hash is supplied.
Real brand logos are visual identity only, never evidence of registered assets, capability or endorsement.
deferred_not_new_primary_routes: Perps and synthetic orderbooks: adapter capability tests first.
Unattended orders, smart-account delegation, leverage loops, LP range orders and chart actions remain P1 capability-gated extensions to existing screens.
Experimental durable conversations extend the conversation workspace; no separate P0 execution authority.
acceptance: 28 total routed views reachable through design index and workspace search.
Mobile/desktop layouts checked at 375, 1024 and 1440 CSS pixels.
Loading/empty/partial/stale/error state selector retained on all routes.
Policy save and financial action approval remain separate.
Native venue risk and source scopes preserved.
